title: Hillenkoetter leaves NICAP as hearings loom

tellings.quote: until he resigned suddenly at the moment where in 1962, Donald Kho, his friend, they were trying to get congressional hearings.

plain: In 1962 a man named Roscoe Hillenkoetter suddenly resigned from NICAP, a private civilian group that investigated UFO reports, just as his friend Donald Keyhoe, who led the group, was trying to get Congress to hold hearings on UFOs. The researcher Richard Dolan tells Michels this without naming a source. He raises the timing because, if it means what he suggests, someone wanted Hillenkoetter out of the way before the hearings could happen.
